# ============================================================
# Fig 4D - dotplot
# ============================================================
```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(scales)
library(forcats)

join <- readRDS("NTCU_join_names_100625.rds")

# 1) Define gene modules
gene_sets <- list(
  "TIL Treg" = c(
    "Foxp3", "Batf", "Ikzf2", "Irf4", "Il2ra", "Il1r2", "Il1rl1", "Ccr8",
    "Ctla4", "Tnfrsf4", "Tnfrsf9", "Tnfrsf18", "Entpd1", "Cd177"
  ),
  "Effector"   = c("Ly6a", "Cxcr3", "Cd40lg"),
  "Th17"       = c("Il17a", "Rora", "Rorc"),
  "Tcm"        = c("Bach2", "Foxp1", "Satb1"),
  "Progenitor" = c("Sell", "Ccr7", "Tcf7", "Lef1", "Il7r")
)

module_levels <- c("TIL Treg", "Th17", "Effector", "Tcm", "Progenitor")

celltype_levels <- c(
  "Batf Treg",
  "Tcm-like Treg (1)",
  "Tcm-like Treg (2)",
  "Th17 Cd4",
  "Tm Cd4",
  "Tcm Cd4",
  "Naive-like Cd4"
)

genes_df <- enframe(gene_sets, name = "module", value = "gene") |>
  unnest(gene) |>
  select(gene, module) |>
  mutate(module = factor(module, levels = module_levels))

# first listed gene appears at top within each module
gene_levels <- rev(unlist(gene_sets[module_levels], use.names = FALSE))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(gene_levels))

# 2) Pull expression + metadata
DefaultAssay(join) <- "RNA"

genes_present <- intersect(genes_df$gene, rownames(join))
genes_missing <- setdiff(genes_df$gene, rownames(join))

if (length(genes_missing) > 0) {
  message("Missing genes dropped: ", paste(genes_missing, collapse = ", "))
}

df <- FetchData(
  object = join,
  vars   = c("t.cell.types", genes_present),
  layer  = "data"
) |>
  rownames_to_column("cell.id") |>
  filter(grepl("Cd4|Treg|Prolif", t.cell.types))

# 3) Long format
df_long <- df |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = all_of(genes_present),
    names_to  = "gene",
    values_to = "expr"
  )

# 4) Summaries
summ <- df_long |>
  group_by(t.cell.types, gene) |>
  summarise(
    mean_expr = mean(expr),
    perc_expr = mean(expr > 0) * 100,
    .groups   = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    genes_df |> filter(gene %in% genes_present),
    by = "gene"
  ) |>
  group_by(gene) |>
  mutate(scaled_mean_expr = as.numeric(scale(mean_expr))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    t.cell.types = factor(t.cell.types, levels = celltype_levels),
    module       = factor(module, levels = module_levels),
    gene         = factor(gene, levels = gene_levels)
  )

# symmetric colour scale around zero, with white exactly at zero
max_abs <- max(abs(summ$scaled_mean_expr), na.rm = TRUE)

fill_breaks <- c(
  -max_abs, -max_abs * 2/3, -max_abs / 3, 0,
   max_abs / 3,  max_abs * 2/3, max_abs * 5/6, max_abs
)

# 5) Plot
p <- ggplot(summ, aes(x = t.cell.types, y = gene)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = scaled_mean_expr, size = perc_expr),
    shape = 21, colour = "black", stroke = 0.4
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c(
      "darkblue", "#6DCCFF", "lightblue2", "white",
      "lightgoldenrod2", "darkorange1", "red", "firebrick"
    ),
    values = scales::rescale(fill_breaks, from = c(-max_abs, max_abs)),
    limits = c(-max_abs, max_abs),
    oob = scales::squish
  ) +
  scale_radius(range = c(1, 10)) +
  scale_y_discrete(position = "right") +
  facet_grid(
    module ~ .,
    scales = "free_y",
    space = "free_y",
    switch = "y"
  ) +
  theme_pubr() +
  theme(
    axis.line         = element_line(colour = "black"),
    panel.background  = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA),
    panel.grid.major  = element_line(colour = "grey", linewidth = 0.2),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),

    axis.text.x       = element_text(size = 16, colour = "black", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y.left  = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y.left = element_blank(),
    axis.title        = element_blank(),

    strip.text.y.left = element_text(size = 16, colour = "black", angle = 0),
    strip.background  = element_blank(),
    strip.placement   = "outside",

    legend.text       = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"),
    legend.title      = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black")
  ) +
  labs(
    fill = "scaled mean expression",
    size = "% expressed"
  )

p

ggsave(
  "join_dotplot_wide_rightlabels.pdf",
  plot = p,
  dpi = 320,
  width = 6,
  height = 10
)
```

# ============================================================
# Fig 4F - cell prop volcano
# ============================================================
```{r}
# 1) Load required libraries
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(lme4)
  library(lmerTest) 
})

# 2) Load the Seurat object 
join <- readRDS("NTCU_join_names_100625.rds")

# ----------------------------
# 3) Metadata: define sample_id, pathology, and filter to w24
# ----------------------------
md <- join@meta.data |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id") |>
  filter(grepl("Treg|Cd4", t.cell.types)) |>
  mutate(
    age = case_when(
      is.na(age) ~ "18 weeks",
      age == "21 weeks" ~ "15 weeks",
      TRUE ~ "24 weeks"
    )
  ) |>
  filter(age != "15 weeks") |>
  mutate(
    final_pathology = case_when(
      phenotype == "NTCU-treated" & version == "old" ~ "NTCU",
      pathology == "NTCU" & version == "new" ~ "NTCU",
      TRUE ~ "Control"
    ),
    # Set levels so Control is the baseline for lmer and log2FC
    final_pathology = factor(final_pathology, levels = c("Control", "NTCU")),
    final_patient = coalesce(patient, patientID),
    final_patient = gsub("mouse", "L", final_patient),
    final_sample_id = paste0(final_pathology, "_", final_patient),
    timepoint = ifelse(grepl("Control_L|NTCU_L", final_sample_id), "w18", "w24")
  ) |>
  # Filtering specifically for the w24 plot 
  filter(timepoint == "w24")

# ----------------------------
# 4) Counts per sample x celltype, with totals and explicit zeros
# ----------------------------
sample_tbl <- md |>
  distinct(final_sample_id, final_pathology, final_patient) |>
  group_by(final_sample_id) |>
  summarise(
    final_pathology = dplyr::first(final_pathology),
    final_patient = dplyr::first(final_patient),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join(md |> dplyr::count(final_sample_id, name = "n_total"), by = "final_sample_id")

celltype_tbl <- md |> dplyr::distinct(t.cell.types)

counts_obs <- md |>
  dplyr::count(final_sample_id, t.cell.types, name = "n_celltype")

counts_complete <- tidyr::crossing(sample_tbl, celltype_tbl) |>
  left_join(counts_obs, by = c("final_sample_id", "t.cell.types")) |>
  mutate(
    n_celltype = ifelse(is.na(n_celltype), 0L, n_celltype),
    prop = n_celltype / n_total
  )

# ----------------------------
# 5) Effect size: log2FC of mean proportions (NTCU/Control)
# ----------------------------
eps <- 1e-6

mean_props <- counts_complete |>
  group_by(final_pathology, t.cell.types) |>
  summarise(mean_prop = mean(prop), .groups = "drop") |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = final_pathology, values_from = mean_prop) |>
  mutate(
    log2FC = log2((NTCU + eps) / (Control + eps)),
    mean_prop_NTCU = NTCU
  )

# ----------------------------
# 6) P-values: Welch t-test on explicit zero-filled proportions
# ----------------------------
message("--- Running t-tests for differential abundance ---")

pvals_res <- counts_complete |>
  group_by(t.cell.types) |>
  summarise(
    p_value = tryCatch({
      # Using standard t-test since mice are independent (no repeated measures at w24)
      t.test(prop ~ final_pathology)$p.value
    }, error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(fdr = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) |>
  arrange(p_value)

# ----------------------------
# 7) Volcano table preparation (3-Tier FDR)
# ----------------------------
volcano_df <- mean_props |>
  left_join(pvals_res, by = "t.cell.types") |>
  mutate(
    neglog10fdr = -log10(fdr),
    sig = case_when(
      fdr < 0.05 ~ "FDR < 0.05",
      fdr < 0.1  ~ "0.05 \u2264 FDR < 0.1",
      TRUE       ~ "FDR \u2265 0.1"
    ),
    sig = factor(sig, levels = c("FDR < 0.05", "0.05 \u2264 FDR < 0.1", "FDR \u2265 0.1"))
  ) |>
  droplevels()

# ----------------------------
# 8) Plotting the Multi-Tier FDR Volcano
# ----------------------------
p <- ggplot(volcano_df, aes(x = log2FC, y = neglog10fdr)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(size = mean_prop_NTCU, fill = sig, colour = sig),
    shape = 21, alpha = 0.9, stroke = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = t.cell.types),
    size = 6, 
    max.overlaps = 30, 
    force = 25,                
    point.padding = 0.8,       
    box.padding = 0.8,         
    min.segment.length = 0,    
    segment.color = "grey40",  
    segment.size = 0.5,        
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("FDR < 0.05" = "firebrick", "0.05 \u2264 FDR < 0.1" = "indianred", "FDR \u2265 0.1" = "black")
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("FDR < 0.05" = "black", "0.05 \u2264 FDR < 0.1" = "black", "FDR \u2265 0.1" = "black")
  ) +
  scale_size(range = c(4, 16)) +
  guides(
    colour = "none",
    fill = guide_legend(order = 1),
    size = guide_legend(order = 2)
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.1, 0.1), linetype = "dashed", colour = "blue", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.1), linetype = "dotted", colour = "blue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", colour = "blue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 22),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Log2(FC) of mean proportion (NTCU/Control)",
    y = "-Log10(FDR)", # Updated to reflect the model change
    fill = "Significance",
    size = "Mean prop. in NTCU"
  )

print(p)

# ----------------------------
# 9) Print significant results
# ----------------------------
volcano_df |>
  mutate(pass_fdr_0.1 = fdr < 0.1) |>
  arrange(p_value) |>
  select(t.cell.types, log2FC, p_value, fdr, pass_fdr_0.1) |>
  print(n = 50)


```

# ============================================================
# Fig 4G - GSEA
# ============================================================

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(fgsea)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Load inputs
# ------------------------------------------------------------
gl_list <- readRDS("gl_list_treg_signatures.rds")
join.markers.names <- readRDS("NTCU_join_markers_names_100625.rds")

mouse_human_genes <- read.delim(
  "http://www.informatics.jax.org/downloads/reports/HOM_MouseHumanSequence.rpt",
  sep = "\t"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Build human-to-mouse orthology table
# ------------------------------------------------------------
mouse <- mouse_human_genes |>
  filter(Common.Organism.Name == "mouse, laboratory")

human <- mouse_human_genes |>
  filter(Common.Organism.Name == "human")

mh_data <- mouse |>
  dplyr::rename(mouse_genes = Symbol) |>
  distinct(DB.Class.Key, mouse_genes) |>
  left_join(
    human |>
      dplyr::rename(genes = Symbol) |>
      distinct(DB.Class.Key, genes),
    by = "DB.Class.Key",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) |>
  tidyr::drop_na(genes, mouse_genes)

# Optional check: human genes with multiple mouse orthologues
mult_hum <- mh_data |>
  count(genes, name = "n") |>
  filter(n > 1)

print(mult_hum)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Convert human literature signatures to mouse gene sets
# ------------------------------------------------------------
gsea_mouse_df <- stack(gl_list) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  dplyr::rename(
    Genes = values,
    Clusters = ind
  ) |>
  left_join(
    mh_data,
    by = c("Genes" = "genes"),
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) |>
  tidyr::drop_na(mouse_genes) |>
  transmute(
    Clusters,
    Genes = mouse_genes
  ) |>
  distinct()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Add BATF Treg pseudobulk signature as another mouse pathway
# ------------------------------------------------------------
batf_human <- readRDS("pb_gene_sigs_Tcell_260825.rds")[["BATF Treg"]] |>
  as_tibble() |>
  filter(
    !is.na(genes),
    !is.na(logFC),
    !is.na(PValue),
    logFC > 0.25,
    PValue < 0.05,
    !grepl("^(AC[0-9]|AL[0-9]|HIST|TRA|TRB|IGH|IGK|IGL|LINC|HBA|HBB|HBD|HBE1|HBG|HBM|HBQ1|HBZ)", genes)
  ) |>
  distinct(genes, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  slice_max(order_by = logFC, n = 300, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  left_join(
    mh_data,
    by = "genes",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) |>
  tidyr::drop_na(mouse_genes) |>
  transmute(
    Clusters = "BATF Treg",
    Genes = mouse_genes
  ) |>
  distinct()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Build pathway list for fgsea
# ------------------------------------------------------------
gsea1 <- bind_rows(
  gsea_mouse_df,
  batf_human
) |>
  mutate(Clusters = as.character(Clusters))

gene_list <- gsea1 |>
  group_by(Clusters) |>
  summarise(Genes = list(unique(Genes)), .groups = "drop") |>
  deframe()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Extract Batf Treg marker table
#    Rank genes in a way more similar to the pseudobulk script
# ------------------------------------------------------------
batf_markers <- join.markers.names |>
  as_tibble() |>
  filter(
    cluster == "Batf Treg",
    !is.na(gene),
    !is.na(avg_log2FC)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    rank_metric = avg_log2FC,
    tie_break_1 = abs(avg_log2FC)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Collapse duplicated gene symbols explicitly
# ------------------------------------------------------------
batf_markers_ranked <- batf_markers |>
  group_by(gene) |>
  arrange(
    desc(abs(rank_metric)),
    desc(tie_break_1),
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) |>
  slice(1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    rank_metric_final = rank_metric +
      sign(rank_metric) * tie_break_1 * 1e-9
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(rank_metric_final))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Build preranked named vector for fgsea
# ------------------------------------------------------------
geneList <- batf_markers_ranked$rank_metric_final
names(geneList) <- batf_markers_ranked$gene
geneList <- sort(geneList, decreasing = TRUE)

stopifnot(is.numeric(geneList))
stopifnot(!is.null(names(geneList)))
stopifnot(!any(is.na(geneList)))
stopifnot(!any(duplicated(names(geneList))))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Check overlap between pathways and ranked universe
# ------------------------------------------------------------
overlap_df <- tibble(
  pathway = names(gene_list),
  size = lengths(gene_list),
  overlap = purrr::map_int(gene_list, ~ sum(.x %in% names(geneList)))
) |>
  arrange(overlap)

print(overlap_df)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10) Run fgsea
# ------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(1)

res <- fgseaMultilevel(
  pathways = gene_list,
  stats = geneList,
  minSize = 10,
  maxSize = 500,
  nproc = 1
) |>
  as_tibble()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11) Tidy results
# ------------------------------------------------------------
gsea_res <- res |>
  left_join(overlap_df, by = "pathway") |>
  mutate(
    sig_col = ifelse(padj < 0.05, "padj < 0.05", "padj ≥ 0.05"),
    sig_col = factor(sig_col, levels = c("padj < 0.05", "padj ≥ 0.05")),
    leadingEdgeSize = lengths(leadingEdge)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(NES))

print(gsea_res)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 12) Plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------
plot_df2 <- gsea_res |>
  arrange(desc(NES)) |>
  mutate(
    neglog10_padj = -log10(pmax(padj, 1e-300)),
    fill_plot = ifelse(padj < 0.05, neglog10_padj, 0),
    pathway = factor(pathway, levels = rev(pathway))
  )

sig_vals <- plot_df2$neglog10_padj[plot_df2$padj < 0.05]
sig_min <- if (length(sig_vals) > 0) min(sig_vals, na.rm = TRUE) else 0
sig_max <- if (length(sig_vals) > 0) max(sig_vals, na.rm = TRUE) else 1

p <- ggplot(plot_df2, aes(x = NES, y = pathway, size = leadingEdgeSize, fill = fill_plot)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, colour = "black", stroke = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("gray80", "mistyrose", "maroon4"),
    values = rescale(c(0, sig_min, sig_max)),
    limits = c(0, sig_max),
    name = expression(-log[10]("adjusted p"))
  ) +
  scale_size(range = c(1.5, 10)) +
  labs(
    x = "NES",
    y = NULL,
    size = "Leading-edge\ngenes"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black"),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11)
  )

print(p)

ggsave(
  filename = "Fig4G.pdf",
  plot = p,
  width = 7,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 320
)

```

# ============================================================
# Fig 4H - triad
# ============================================================
```{r}
library(ggtern)

pb_gene_sigs <- readRDS("Batf_Treg_exp_pb_sigs.rds")

pb_sigs <- bind_rows(pb_gene_sigs, .id = "final_group") %>% 
  filter(!grepl("^Ac|^Hb|^Trg|^Tra|^Trb|Rik", genes)) %>% 
  reshape2::dcast(genes ~ final_group, value.var = "logFC")

pb_sigs_norm <- pb_sigs %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(exp(c_across(Control:NTCU_expanded))),
    Control_prop = exp(Control) / total,
    NTCU_prop = exp(NTCU) / total,
    NTCU_expanded_prop = exp(NTCU_expanded) / total
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  left_join(
    bind_rows(pb_gene_sigs, .id = "final_group") %>% 
      filter(logFC > 0) %>% 
      filter(!grepl("^Ac|^Hb|^Trg|^Tra|^Trb", genes)) %>%
      mutate(Significance = ifelse(final_group == "Control" & logFC > 0.35 & FDR < 0.1, "Enriched in Control",
                                   ifelse(final_group == "NTCU" & logFC > 0.35 & FDR < 0.1, "Enriched in NTCU",
                                          ifelse(final_group == "NTCU_expanded" & logFC > 0.35 & FDR < 0.1, "Enriched in NTCU expanded", NA)))) %>% 
      select(genes, Significance) %>% 
      drop_na(Significance) %>% 
      distinct() %>% 
      filter(genes != "Mid1"),       # remove this gene which is present in NTCU & NTCU_expanded
    by = "genes"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(Significance = ifelse(is.na(Significance), "ns", Significance))

# if we want to plot the top 5 genes per group
#geneSig <- bind_rows(pb_gene_sigs, .id = "final_group") %>% 
#  filter(logFC > 0) %>% 
#  filter(!grepl("^Ac|^Hb|^Trg|^Tra|^Trb|Rik", genes)) %>% 
#  arrange(desc(logFC)) %>% 
#  group_by(final_group) %>% 
#  slice_head(n=5) 
# or if we want to plot selected genes
geneSig <- bind_rows(pb_gene_sigs, .id = "final_group") %>% 
  filter(logFC > 0 & FDR < 0.1) %>% 
  filter(!grepl("^Ac|^Hb|^Trg|^Tra|^Trb|Rik", genes)) %>% 
  filter(genes %in% c("Klf2", "Klf3", "Lef1", "Irf1", "Stat1", "S1pr1", "Areg", "Cd86", "Itgb3", "Itgb1", "Slamf6",
                      "Il5", "Il17a", "Il22", "Ifitm2",
                      "Ccl4", "Cxcr6", "Pdcd1", "Il10", "Itgav", "Ccr8", "Nkg7", "Lgals3", "Tnfrsf8", "Il2ra", "Lag3", "Dusp4", "Havcr2", "Cxcl10", "Spp1"))
geneSig <- pb_sigs_norm %>% 
  mutate(label = ifelse(genes %in% geneSig$genes, genes, NA)) %>% 
  drop_na(label)

#genes <- c(pull(arrange(geneSig, avg_log2FC), gene)[c(1:40)], pull(arrange(geneSig, desc(avg_log2FC)), gene)[c(1:40)])
#geneSig <- geneSig[geneSig$gene %in% c(genes, "Foxp3", "Tigit", "Lag3", "Havcr2", "Il2ra", "Sell", ""),]


ggtern(data = pb_sigs_norm, aes(x = Control_prop, y = NTCU_prop, z = NTCU_expanded_prop)) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = c("ns" = "gray50","Enriched in Control" = "dodgerblue", "Enriched in NTCU" = "plum", "Enriched in NTCU expanded" = "firebrick1")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Control", 
    y = "NTCU", 
    z = "NTCU expanded"
    )
ggsave("pb_exp_ternary_plot.pdf", dpi=320, width=13, height=13)
```

# ============================================================
# Fig 4I - sig heatmap
# ============================================================
```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(rstatix)
library(Seurat)

# 1. Load data
batf_sub_ucell <- readRDS("seu_batf_ucell.rds")
batf_ucell <- batf_sub_ucell@meta.data  

# 2. Filter and reshape data
batf_ucell1 <- batf_ucell %>% 
  select(matches("GOBP|HALLMARK|exp_group|patient|pathology")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(patient, pathology, exp_group), 
    names_to = "signature", 
    values_to = "score"
  ) %>% 
  filter(grepl("MHC_MOLECULE|TGF_BETA|TNFA|IL2|CHEMOTAXIS|INFLAMMATORY", signature))

# 3. Run Linear Mixed Models (omitting confidence intervals for speed)
sigs <- unique(batf_ucell1$signature)
mem_mods <- list()

for (i in sigs) {
  df <- batf_ucell1 %>% filter(signature == i)
  
  mod <- lmer(score ~ exp_group + (1 | patient), data = df, REML = FALSE)
  
  results_df <- as.data.frame(summary(mod)$coefficients) %>% 
    mutate(exp_group = row.names(.))
  
  mem_mods[[i]] <- results_df
}

# 4. Format LMM results for heatmap mapping
mem_mods1 <- bind_rows(mem_mods, .id = "signature") %>% 
  filter(!grepl("Intercept", exp_group)) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(
    std.error = `Std. Error`,
    t_value = `t value`,
    p_value = `Pr(>|t|)`
  ) %>% 
  bind_rows(
    data.frame(
      signature = sigs,
      Estimate = 0,
      p_value = 1,
      exp_group = "Control"
    )
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    p.adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    exp_group = gsub("exp_group", "", exp_group)
  ) %>% 
  add_significance("p.adj")

# Clean up non-significant labels
mem_mods1$p.adj.signif[mem_mods1$p.adj.signif == "ns"] <- ""

# 5. Prepare plot data (using case_when for cleaner renaming)
plot_data <- mem_mods1 %>% 
  group_by(signature) %>% 
  mutate(
    scaled_estimate = scale(Estimate),
    signature = case_when(
      grepl("MHC_MOLECULE", signature) ~ "TCR_pMHC_contact via APC",
      grepl("CHEMOTAXIS", signature)   ~ "T_CELL_CHEMOTAXIS",
      grepl("IL2", signature)          ~ "IL2_STA5_SIGNALLING",
      grepl("INFLAMMATORY", signature) ~ "INFLAMMATORY RESPONSE",
      grepl("TGF_BETA", signature)     ~ "TGF_BETA SIGNALLING",
      TRUE                             ~ "TNFA_SIGNALLING VIA_NFKB"
    )
  ) %>% 
  filter(signature %in% c("TCR_pMHC_contact via APC", "IL2_STA5_SIGNALLING", "T_CELL_CHEMOTAXIS"))

# 6. Plot and Save
ggplot(data = plot_data, mapping = aes(y = signature, x = exp_group)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = scaled_estimate), color = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(label = p.adj.signif), color = "black", size = 6, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "dodgerblue3", 
    mid = "white", 
    high = "firebrick", 
    midpoint = 0
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title.y  = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x  = element_text(size = 15, color = 'black', hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x   = element_text(size = 10, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, angle = 45, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y   = element_text(size = 10, vjust = 0.5, color = "black"),
    legend.text   = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    legend.title  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = 'top',
    axis.line   = element_blank(), 
    axis.ticks  = element_blank()
  )

ggsave("MEM_UCell_sigs_exp_hm1.pdf", dpi = 320, width = 7, height = 8)
```


# ============================================================
# Fig 4J - circos
# ============================================================
```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load required libraries
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
library(tidyverse)
library(reshape2)
library(circlize)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Load the data & Apply Global Filters
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
data <- read.csv("met_dLN_Lung_CP_NTCU-TS250325.csv")

# Filter out Stem-like CD4 cells specifically from the Lesion (L) compartment
data <- data %>%
  filter(!(grepl("Stem-like Cd4", cell.types, ignore.case = TRUE) & loc == "L"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Loop over both pathologies to generate and save both plots
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
pathologies_to_plot <- c("Control", "NTCU")

for (tgt_pathology in pathologies_to_plot) {
  
  message(paste("\nGenerating Circos plot for:", tgt_pathology))
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. Prepare the shared cells data (df_tmp)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  df_tmp <- data %>%
    filter(pathology == tgt_pathology) %>% 
    filter(loc != "dLN") %>% 
    select(cdr3, patient, loc, cell.types) %>% 
    drop_na(cdr3) %>% 
    filter(grepl("Cd4|Treg", cell.types, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>% 
    group_by(cdr3, patient, loc, cell.types) %>% 
    summarise(n_cdr3 = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
    mutate(cell.types_loc = paste0(cell.types, "_", loc)) %>% 
    reshape2::dcast(cdr3 + patient ~ cell.types_loc, value.var = "n_cdr3") 
  
  df_tmp[is.na(df_tmp)] <- 0
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. Iterate over cell types to build the chord_list
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  cell_types <- colnames(df_tmp)[-c(1, 2)] 
  chord_list <- list()
  
  for(i in seq_along(cell_types)) {
    current_cell_type <- cell_types[i]
    
    df_tmp_tmp <- df_tmp %>% 
      filter(.data[[current_cell_type]] > 0) %>% 
      reshape2::melt(id.vars = c("cdr3", "patient", current_cell_type)) 
    
    total_current_ct <- df_tmp_tmp %>% 
      filter(value > 0) %>% 
      group_by(variable) %>% 
      summarise(total_current = sum(.data[[current_cell_type]]), .groups = "drop") %>% 
      dplyr::rename(to = variable)
    
    chord_list[[current_cell_type]] <- total_current_ct
  }
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. Build base chord dataframes
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  chord_df_shared <- bind_rows(chord_list, .id = "from") %>% 
    mutate(
      from = as.character(from),
      to   = as.character(to),          
      a = pmin(from, to),             
      b = pmax(from, to)
    ) %>% 
    group_by(from = a, to = b) %>%
    summarise(value = sum(total_current), .groups = "drop") 
  
  chord_df1 <- bind_rows(chord_list, .id = "major_cell_type") %>% 
    group_by(major_cell_type) %>% 
    summarise(total_shared = sum(total_current), .groups = "drop")
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 6. Calculate unshared cells from original data
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  a <- data %>% 
    filter(grepl("Cd4|Treg", cell.types, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>% 
    filter(loc != "dLN") %>% 
    drop_na(cdr3) %>% 
    group_by(cdr3, cell.types, loc, patient, pathology) %>% 
    summarise(n_cdr3 = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
    mutate(cell.types_loc = paste0(cell.types, "_", loc)) %>% 
    reshape2::dcast(cdr3 + patient + pathology ~ cell.types_loc, value.var = "n_cdr3") 
  
  a[is.na(a)] <- 0
  
  pheno_cols <- setdiff(colnames(a), c("cdr3", "patient", "pathology"))
  
  unshared_all_df <- a %>% 
    mutate(total_cells_for_clone = rowSums(across(all_of(pheno_cols)))) %>% 
    reshape2::melt(id.vars = c("cdr3", "patient", "pathology", "total_cells_for_clone"), value.name = "n_cdr3") %>% 
    filter(n_cdr3 > 0) %>%
    mutate(is_unshared = (n_cdr3 == total_cells_for_clone)) %>% 
    filter(is_unshared) %>% 
    separate(variable, into = c("cell.types", "loc"), sep = "_(?=[^_]+$)") %>% 
    group_by(cell.types, loc, pathology) %>% 
    summarise(n = sum(n_cdr3), .groups = "drop") 
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 7. Merge shared and unshared data into final format
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  all_sectors_base <- unshared_all_df %>% 
    filter(pathology == tgt_pathology) %>% 
    mutate(major_cell_type = paste0(cell.types, "_", loc)) %>% 
    select(major_cell_type, total_unshared = n)
  
  chord_df2 <- all_sectors_base %>% 
    left_join(chord_df1, by = "major_cell_type") %>% 
    mutate(
      total_shared = replace_na(total_shared, 0),
      total_unshared = total_unshared / 2, 
      from = major_cell_type,
      to = major_cell_type,
      value = total_unshared
    ) %>% 
    select(from, to, value) %>% 
    bind_rows(chord_df_shared) %>% 
    mutate(value = replace_na(value, 0)) %>%
    filter(value > 0)
  
  chord_df <- chord_df2 %>% mutate(across(c(from, to), as.character))
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 8. Setup aesthetics for the Plot (Compartments and Ribbons)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  get_comp <- function(x) sub(".*_(L|CP)$", "\\1", x)
  sectors <- unique(c(chord_df$from, chord_df$to))
  compartment <- get_comp(sectors)
  
  sector_order <- sectors[order(factor(compartment, levels = c("L","CP")), sectors)]
  grp_ord <- get_comp(sector_order)
  
  small_gap <- 2; big_gap <- 12
  last_in_group <- c(which(grp_ord[-length(grp_ord)] != grp_ord[-1]), length(grp_ord))
  gap_after <- rep(small_gap, length(sector_order)); gap_after[last_in_group] <- big_gap
  
  comp_cols <- c(L = "#4E79A7", 
                 CP = "#59A14F")
  grid.col  <- setNames(comp_cols[grp_ord], sector_order)
  
  all_sectors <- unique(c(chord_df$from, chord_df$to))
  src_palette <- setNames(rep("gray70", length(all_sectors)), all_sectors)
  
  # Safe palette assignment in case a subset has 0 Batf Tregs
  if("Batf Treg_L" %in% names(src_palette)) src_palette["Batf Treg_L"] <- "firebrick"
  if("Effector Treg_CP" %in% names(src_palette)) src_palette["Effector Treg_CP"] <- "firebrick"
  
  link_col <- unname(as.character(src_palette[match(chord_df$from, names(src_palette))]))
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 9. Render the Circos Plot
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Dynamic file name generated per loop
  pdf_name <- paste0("", tgt_pathology, "_updated.pdf")
  pdf(pdf_name, width=8, height=8)
  
  circos.clear()
  circos.par(start.degree = 90, gap.after = gap_after, track.margin = c(0.01, 0.01))
  
  chordDiagram(
    x = chord_df,
    order = sector_order,
    grid.col = grid.col,     
    col = link_col,          
    transparency = 0.15,
    annotationTrack = "grid",
    reduce = 0,               
    preAllocateTracks = list(track.height = 0.06)
  )
  
  circos.trackPlotRegion(
    track.index = 1, panel.fun = function(x, y) {
      circos.text(get.cell.meta.data("xcenter"),
                  get.cell.meta.data("ylim")[2] + mm_y(1.5),
                  labels = get.cell.meta.data("sector.index"),
                  facing = "clockwise", niceFacing = TRUE,
                  adj = c(0, 0.5), cex = 0.55)
    }, bg.border = NA
  )
  
  # Draw the legends
  legend("topleft",  legend = names(comp_cols), fill = comp_cols, bty = "n", title = "Compartment")
  legend("topright", legend = c("Batf Treg_*","Effector Treg_CP","Others"),
         fill = c("firebrick","firebrick","gray70"), bty = "n", title = "Ribbons")
  
  dev.off()
  message(paste("Saved successfully:", pdf_name))
}

```

# ============================================================
# Fig 4K - stacked barplot
# ============================================================
```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 0. Load Libraries & Setup
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
library(Seurat); library(dplyr); library(ggplot2); library(patchwork)
library(tidyr); library(lme4); library(tibble); library(forcats)
library(broom.mixed); library(purrr)

lung_path <- "newNTCU_Lung-TS150425.rds"
cp_path   <- "newNTCU_CP-TS150425.rds"
dln_path  <- "newNTCU_Tcells_dLN-TS150425.rds"

# Memory-efficient extraction
extract_md <- function(path, loc_name) {
  if(!file.exists(path)) stop(paste("File not found:", path))
  obj <- readRDS(path)
  md <- as_tibble(obj@meta.data, rownames = "barcode") %>% 
    mutate(loc = loc_name)
  rm(obj); gc()
  return(md)
}

# Global Vectorized p-value formatter
format_pval <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ "n.s.",
    p < 0.001 ~ "< 0.001",
    TRUE ~ paste0("= ", round(p, 3))
  )
}

# Load, Filter & Normalize Phenotype Names
cd4_data <- bind_rows(
  extract_md(lung_path, "L"), 
  extract_md(cp_path, "CP"), 
  extract_md(dln_path, "dLN")
) %>%
  filter(grepl("Cd4|Treg", cell.types)) %>%
  drop_na(cdr3) %>%
  mutate(
    patient = factor(patient),
    cell.types = case_when(
      cell.types == "Th17 Cd4" ~ "Th17 CD4",
      cell.types == "Tcm Cd4" ~ "Tcm CD4",
      cell.types == "Naive Cd4" ~ "Naive CD4",
      cell.types == "Tem Cd4" ~ "Tem CD4",
      cell.types == "Naive-like Cd4" ~ "Progenitor CD4",
      TRUE ~ cell.types
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Define Anchors & Plotting Palettes
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
cell_order <- c("Th17 CD4", "Tcm-like Treg", "Tcm CD4", "Naive CD4", "Effector Treg")
lesion_phenotypes <- c("Th17 CD4", "Tcm-like Treg", "Tem CD4", "Progenitor CD4", "Batf Treg")

pheno_colors <- c(
  "Th17 CD4"      = "lightpink2", 
  "Tcm-like Treg" = "lightseagreen", 
  "Tcm CD4"       = "burlywood", 
  "Naive CD4"     = "gold1", 
  "Effector Treg" = "firebrick"
)

lesion_colors <- c(
  "Th17 CD4"       = "lightpink2",
  "Tcm-like Treg"  = "lightseagreen",
  "Tem CD4"        = "burlywood",
  "Progenitor CD4" = "gold1",
  "Batf Treg"      = "firebrick"
)

lung_clone_counts <- cd4_data %>%
  filter(loc == "L") %>%
  group_by(patient, cdr3) %>%
  summarise(n_total_lung = n(), .groups = "drop")

batf_anchors <- cd4_data %>%
  filter(loc == "L", cell.types == "Batf Treg") %>%
  group_by(patient, cdr3, pathology) %>%
  summarise(n_batf = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(lung_clone_counts, by = c("patient", "cdr3")) %>%
  mutate(
    exp_group = factor(pathology, levels = c("Control", "NTCU"))
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Blood Sharing Bias Stats & Stacked Bar
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
run_within_group_blood_bias <- function(target_pheno, target_group) {
  blood_pool <- cd4_data %>% filter(loc == "CP")
  prop_background <- mean(blood_pool$cell.types == target_pheno, na.rm = TRUE)
  if(prop_background == 0 || is.na(prop_background)) return(NULL)
  
  clones_in_blood <- blood_pool %>% filter(cell.types == target_pheno) %>% pull(cdr3)
  model_df <- batf_anchors %>%
    filter(exp_group == target_group) %>%
    mutate(
      is_shared = ifelse(cdr3 %in% clones_in_blood, 1, 0),
      clone_size = scale(log(n_total_lung)) 
    )
  
  if(sum(model_df$is_shared) < 2 || length(unique(model_df$is_shared)) < 2) return(NULL)
  
  fit <- tryCatch({
    glmer(is_shared ~ clone_size + (1 | patient), data = model_df, family = binomial, 
          offset = rep(log(prop_background/(1-prop_background)), nrow(model_df)))
  }, error = function(e) return(NULL))
  
  if(is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
  
  broom.mixed::tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) %>%
    filter(term == "(Intercept)") %>% 
    transmute(Group = target_group, CellType = target_pheno, 
              OR = estimate, CI_low = conf.low, CI_high = conf.high, Pval = p.value)
}

blood_bias_stats <- bind_rows(
  lapply(c("Control", "NTCU"), function(g) {
    bind_rows(lapply(cell_order, function(p) run_within_group_blood_bias(p, g)))
  })
)

blood_sharing_map <- cd4_data %>%
  filter(loc == "CP", cell.types %in% cell_order) %>%
  distinct(cdr3, patient, cell.types)

plot_df_bar_absolute <- batf_anchors %>%
  left_join(blood_sharing_map, by = c("cdr3", "patient")) %>%
  mutate(cell.types = replace_na(as.character(cell.types), "Unshared")) %>%
  group_by(patient, exp_group, cell.types) %>%
  summarise(n_clones = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  complete(patient, exp_group, cell.types = c(cell_order, "Unshared"), fill = list(n_clones = 0)) %>%
  group_by(patient, exp_group) %>%
  mutate(prop = (n_clones / sum(n_clones)) * 100) %>%
  replace_na(list(prop = 0)) %>%
  group_by(exp_group, cell.types) %>%
  summarise(mean_prop = mean(prop), se = sd(prop) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop") %>%
  replace_na(list(se = 0))

plot_df_bar_scaled <- plot_df_bar_absolute %>%
  filter(cell.types != "Unshared") %>%
  left_join(blood_bias_stats, by = c("exp_group" = "Group", "cell.types" = "CellType")) %>%
  mutate(
    exp_group = factor(exp_group, levels = c("Control", "NTCU")),
    cell.types = factor(cell.types, levels = cell_order),
    stat_label = case_when(
      cell.types == "Effector Treg" & !is.na(OR) ~ paste0("OR=", round(OR, 1), "\n(p", format_pval(Pval), ")"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(exp_group, desc(cell.types)) %>%
  group_by(exp_group) %>%
  mutate(cs = cumsum(mean_prop), mid_y = cs - (mean_prop / 2)) %>%
  ungroup()

p_stacked <- ggplot(plot_df_bar_scaled, aes(x = exp_group, fill = cell.types)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = mean_prop), color = "black", position = "stack") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = cs - se, ymax = cs + se), width = 0.25) +
  geom_label(aes(y = mid_y, label = stat_label), 
             color = "black", fill = "white", alpha = 0.8,
             size = 3, fontface = "bold", lineheight = 0.8, 
             label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(0.15, "lines"), na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pheno_colors) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(y = "Absolute % of Shared Clones", x = NULL, title = "Blood Sharing") +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(), axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Blood Sharing Forest Plot (UPDATED: Control & NTCU only)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
run_blood_vs_control <- function(target_pheno) {
  blood_pool <- cd4_data %>% filter(loc == "CP")
  clones_in_blood <- blood_pool %>% filter(cell.types == target_pheno) %>% pull(cdr3)
  
  model_df <- batf_anchors %>%
    mutate(
      is_shared = ifelse(cdr3 %in% clones_in_blood, 1, 0),
      clone_size = scale(log(n_total_lung))
    )
  
  if(sum(model_df$is_shared) < 2) return(NULL)
  
  fit <- tryCatch({
    glmer(is_shared ~ exp_group + clone_size + (1 | patient), data = model_df, family = binomial)
  }, error = function(e) return(NULL))
  
  if(is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
  
  broom.mixed::tidy(fit, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(term == "exp_groupNTCU") %>% 
    transmute(Group = "NTCU/Control", CellType = target_pheno, 
              OR = estimate, CI_low = conf.low, CI_high = conf.high, Pval = p.value)
}

blood_direct_stats <- bind_rows(lapply(cell_order, run_blood_vs_control))

# MODIFIED: Only use blood_bias_stats for the plot
plot_df_forest_blood <- blood_bias_stats %>%
  filter(OR < 1e6, !is.na(CI_low), !is.infinite(CI_high)) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Control", "NTCU")), # Removed NTCU/Control level
    Label = paste0("OR: ", round(OR, 1), "\np ", format_pval(Pval))
  )

p_forest_blood <- ggplot(plot_df_forest_blood, aes(x = OR, y = fct_reorder(CellType, OR, .fun = max, .na_rm = TRUE))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = CI_low, xmax = CI_high), height = 0.2) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = CellType), shape = 21, size = 5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Label, x = CI_high), hjust = -0.1, size = 3, lineheight = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~Group) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = pheno_colors) +
  scale_x_log10(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.3))) + 
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Odds Ratio (95% CI)", y = NULL, title = "Blood Sharing Bias") + 
  theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Within-Lung Sharing Data Prep
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
sharing_partners <- cd4_data %>%
  filter(loc == "L") %>%
  inner_join(batf_anchors, by = c("patient", "cdr3")) %>%
  group_by(patient, cdr3) %>%
  mutate(is_anchor = row_number() == match("Batf Treg", cell.types)) %>%
  filter(!is_anchor) %>%
  ungroup() %>% select(-is_anchor)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Within-Lesion Bias by Group & Stacked Bar
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
run_lesion_group_bias <- function(target_pheno, target_group) {
  if(is.na(target_pheno)) return(NULL)
  lung_pool <- cd4_data %>% filter(loc == "L")
  prop_background <- mean(lung_pool$cell.types == target_pheno, na.rm = TRUE)
  if(prop_background == 0 || is.na(prop_background)) return(NULL)
  
  model_df <- sharing_partners %>%
    filter(exp_group == target_group) %>%
    mutate(
      is_target = ifelse(cell.types == target_pheno, 1, 0),
      clone_size = scale(log(n_total_lung))
    )
  
  if(sum(model_df$is_target) < 2 || length(unique(model_df$is_target)) < 2) return(NULL)
  
  fit <- tryCatch({
    glmer(is_target ~ clone_size + (1 | patient), data = model_df, family = binomial, 
          offset = rep(log(prop_background/(1-prop_background)), nrow(model_df)))
  }, error = function(e) return(NULL))
  
  if(is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
  
  broom.mixed::tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) %>%
    filter(term == "(Intercept)") %>% 
    transmute(exp_group = target_group, cell.types = target_pheno, 
              OR = estimate, CI_low = conf.low, CI_high = conf.high, Pval = p.value)
}

lesion_groups <- c("Control", "NTCU")
lesion_bias_stats <- bind_rows(
  lapply(lesion_groups, function(g) {
    bind_rows(lapply(lesion_phenotypes, function(p) run_lesion_group_bias(p, g)))
  })
)

lesion_sharing_map <- sharing_partners %>%
  filter(cell.types %in% lesion_phenotypes) %>%
  distinct(patient, cdr3, exp_group, cell.types)

plot_df_lesion_absolute <- batf_anchors %>%
  left_join(lesion_sharing_map, by = c("cdr3", "patient", "exp_group")) %>%
  mutate(cell.types = replace_na(as.character(cell.types), "Unshared")) %>%
  group_by(patient, exp_group, cell.types) %>%
  summarise(n_clones = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  complete(patient, exp_group = lesion_groups, cell.types = c(lesion_phenotypes, "Unshared"), fill = list(n_clones = 0)) %>%
  group_by(patient, exp_group) %>%
  mutate(prop = (n_clones / sum(n_clones)) * 100) %>%
  replace_na(list(prop = 0)) %>%
  group_by(exp_group, cell.types) %>%
  summarise(mean_prop = mean(prop), se = sd(prop) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop") %>%
  replace_na(list(se = 0))

lesion_summary_scaled <- plot_df_lesion_absolute %>%
  filter(cell.types != "Unshared") %>%
  left_join(lesion_bias_stats, by = c("exp_group", "cell.types")) %>%
  mutate(
    exp_group = factor(exp_group, levels = c("Control", "NTCU")),
    cell.types = factor(cell.types, levels = lesion_phenotypes),
    stat_label = case_when(
      cell.types == "Batf Treg" & !is.na(OR) ~ paste0("OR=", round(OR, 1), "\n(p", format_pval(Pval), ")"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(exp_group, desc(cell.types)) %>%
  group_by(exp_group) %>%
  mutate(cs = cumsum(mean_prop), mid_y = cs - (mean_prop / 2)) %>%
  ungroup()

p_lesion <- ggplot(lesion_summary_scaled, aes(x = exp_group, fill = cell.types)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = mean_prop), color = "black", position = "stack") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = cs - se, ymax = cs + se), width = 0.25) +
  geom_label(aes(y = mid_y, label = stat_label), 
             color = "black", fill = "white", alpha = 0.8,
             size = 3, fontface = "bold", lineheight = 0.8, 
             label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(0.15, "lines"), na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = lesion_colors) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(y = "Absolute % of Shared Clones", x = NULL, title = "Within-Lung Sharing") +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(), axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))

# Reverse Bias Function: Comparing shared clones vs background Lung distribution
run_rev_blood_bias <- function(target_pheno, target_group) {
  lung_pool <- cd4_data %>% filter(loc == "L")
  prop_background <- mean(lung_pool$cell.types == target_pheno, na.rm = TRUE)
  if(prop_background == 0 || is.na(prop_background)) return(NULL)
  
  clones_in_lung <- lung_pool %>% filter(cell.types == target_pheno) %>% pull(cdr3)
  
  model_df <- eff_treg_blood_anchors %>%
    filter(exp_group == target_group) %>%
    mutate(
      is_shared = ifelse(cdr3 %in% clones_in_lung, 1, 0),
      clone_size = scale(log(n_total_blood))
    )
  
  if(sum(model_df$is_shared) < 2 || length(unique(model_df$is_shared)) < 2) return(NULL)
  
  fit <- tryCatch({
    glmer(is_shared ~ clone_size + (1 | patient), data = model_df, family = binomial, 
          offset = rep(log(prop_background/(1-prop_background)), nrow(model_df)))
  }, error = function(e) return(NULL))
  
  if(is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
  
  broom.mixed::tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) %>%
    filter(term == "(Intercept)") %>% 
    transmute(Group = target_group, CellType = target_pheno, 
              OR = estimate, CI_low = conf.low, CI_high = conf.high, Pval = p.value)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Print Exact OR and P-Values for All Forest Plots
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

# Helper function to format p-values to 2 decimal places using 10^x notation
format_exact_p <- function(p) {
  sapply(p, function(x) {
    if (is.na(x)) return("NA")
    if (x >= 0.01) {
      return(sprintf("%.2f", x))
    } else {
      # Convert to scientific format (e.g., 1.23e-04)
      sci <- sprintf("%.2e", x)
      # Replace the 'e' notation with ' x 10^' and remove leading zeros in the exponent
      sci <- sub("e([-+]?)0*([0-9]+)", " x 10^\\1\\2", sci)
      return(sci)
    }
  })
}

# Compile and unify the stats from the three forest plot dataframes
all_forest_stats <- bind_rows(
  plot_df_forest_lesion %>% 
    rename(Condition = exp_group, Cell = cell.types) %>% 
    mutate(Plot_Type = "1. Within-Lung Bias"),
  
  plot_df_forest_blood %>% 
    rename(Condition = Group, Cell = CellType) %>% 
    mutate(Plot_Type = "2. Lung-to-Blood Bias"),
  
  plot_df_rev_forest %>% 
    rename(Condition = Group, Cell = CellType) %>% 
    mutate(Plot_Type = "3. Blood-to-Lung Bias")
) %>%
  select(Plot_Type, Condition, Cell, OR, Pval) %>%
  mutate(
    OR_Rounded = sprintf("%.2f", OR),
    Pval_Exact = format_exact_p(Pval)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Plot_Type, Condition, Cell) %>%
  select(Plot_Type, Condition, Cell, OR_Rounded, Pval_Exact)

# Print the cleanly formatted summary table to the console
cat("\n=== EXACT ODDS RATIOS AND P-VALUES FOR FOREST PLOTS ===\n\n")
print(as.data.frame(all_forest_stats), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. PD-L1 boxplots, MFI and frequency, dLN vs ndLN
# ------------------------------------------------------------

make_pdl1_boxplot <- function(
    data,
    subset_keep,
    variable_keep,
    marker_type_keep,
    ylab_text,
    file_stub,
    out_dir
) {
  
  plot_df <- data |>
    dplyr::filter(
      subset == subset_keep,
      ln_type %in% c("mLN", "iLN"),
      Treatment %in% c("CTRL", "NTCU"),
      variable == variable_keep,
      marker_type == marker_type_keep
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(value)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("CTRL", "NTCU"),
                         labels = c("Control", "NTCU")),
      tissue = factor(ln_type, levels = c("mLN", "iLN"),
                      labels = c("dLN", "ndLN"))
    )
  
  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {
    message("No data for ", subset_keep, " / ", variable_keep)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  stats_df <- plot_df |>
    dplyr::group_by(tissue) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      p = safe_wilcox(dplyr::pick(Treatment, value)),
      ymax = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      ymin = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      span = pmax(ymax - ymin, ymax * 0.15, 1),
      line_y = ymax + 0.10 * span,
      text_y = ymax + 0.22 * span,
      label = dplyr::if_else(
        is.na(p),
        "p = NA",
        paste0("p = ", scales::pvalue(p, accuracy = 0.001, add_p = FALSE))
      )
    )
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Treatment, y = value)) +
    geom_boxplot(
      aes(fill = Treatment),
      width = 0.55,
      outlier.shape = NA,
      alpha = 0.18,
      colour = "black"
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      aes(colour = Treatment),
      width = 0.12,
      size = 2.6,
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = stats_df,
      aes(x = 1, xend = 2, y = line_y, yend = line_y),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = stats_df,
      aes(x = 1.5, y = text_y, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 4
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ tissue, nrow = 1, scales = "fixed") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Control" = "white", "NTCU" = "white")) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("Control" = "#4C78A8", "NTCU" = "#B22222")) +
    labs(
      title = subset_keep,
      x = NULL,
      y = ylab_text
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 10)
    )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0(file_stub, "_", subset_keep, ".pdf")),
    plot = p,
    width = 5.8,
    height = 4.6,
    dpi = 320
  )
  
  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
  library(patchwork)
})

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# helper: Wilcoxon p-value
# ------------------------------------------------------------
safe_wilcox2 <- function(df) {
  df2 <- df |>
    filter(!is.na(Treatment), !is.na(value)) |>
    mutate(Treatment = droplevels(factor(Treatment)))
  
  if (n_distinct(df2$Treatment) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  if (any(table(df2$Treatment) < 1)) return(NA_real_)
  
  suppressWarnings(
    tryCatch(
      wilcox.test(value ~ Treatment, data = df2, exact = FALSE)$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    )
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# common colours
# ------------------------------------------------------------
cols <- c("Control" = "#3778bf", "NTCU" = "#c32f2f")

                    levels = c("mLN", "iLN"),

# same y axis within panel N
overall_ymax_N <- max(plot_df_pdl1$value, na.rm = TRUE)

span_N <- pmax(overall_ymax_N - overall_ymin_N, overall_ymax_N * 0.15, 1)

stats_pdl1 <- plot_df_pdl1 |>
  group_by(tissue) |>
  summarise(
```

```{r}
get_summary_stats <- function(df, value_col, label) {
  
  value_sym <- rlang::sym(value_col)
  
  group_stats <- df |>
    group_by(Treatment) |>
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mean = mean(!!value_sym, na.rm = TRUE),
      median = median(!!value_sym, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd = sd(!!value_sym, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  mean_ntcu <- group_stats |>
    filter(Treatment == "NTCU") |>
    pull(mean)
  
  mean_fty <- group_stats |>
    filter(Treatment == "NTCU FTY720") |>
    pull(mean)
  
  median_ntcu <- group_stats |>
    filter(Treatment == "NTCU") |>
    pull(median)
  
  median_fty <- group_stats |>
    filter(Treatment == "NTCU FTY720") |>
    pull(median)
  
  t_p <- t.test(reformulate("Treatment", response = value_col), data = df)$p.value
  w_p <- wilcox.test(reformulate("Treatment", response = value_col), data = df)$p.value
  
  tibble(
    population = label,
    n_ntcu = sum(df$Treatment == "NTCU"),
    n_fty720 = sum(df$Treatment == "NTCU FTY720"),
    mean_ntcu = mean_ntcu,
    mean_fty720 = mean_fty,
    median_ntcu = median_ntcu,
    median_fty720 = median_fty,
    fold_change_mean_ntcu_over_fty720 = mean_ntcu / mean_fty,
    fold_change_median_ntcu_over_fty720 = median_ntcu / median_fty,
    p_t_test = t_p,
    p_wilcox = w_p
  )
}

stats_treg <- get_summary_stats(lung, "Treg", "Total Tregs")
stats_cd62l <- get_summary_stats(cd62l_neg, "Count", "CD62Llo Tregs")
stats_ox40_gitr <- get_summary_stats(lung, "GITR_OX40_Treg", "OX40+GITR+ Tregs")

stats_out <- bind_rows(stats_treg, stats_cd62l, stats_ox40_gitr)

stats_out
```
